description: Figure 5 presents a bar chart illustrating the performance gain in percentage points on various tasks achieved through predictive rollout search. The horizontal axis displays the task categories: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet-72B-VL, and Claude-3.5-Sonnet-Qwen-72B-VL, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, represents the performance gain, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, incrementing by 10 units. Two bars are present for each task category, differentiated by color: a blue bar representing “Strong Supervision” and an orange bar representing “Weak Supervision”. For GPT-4o, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 54.1%, while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 48.4%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 40.4%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 34.8%. Finally, for Claude-3.5-Sonnet-Qwen-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 44.7%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 39.3%. The bars are grouped by task category, with the “Strong Supervision” bar positioned to the left of the “Weak Supervision” bar within each group.
